title: Cities and movement: Task 2 - Public transport
instructions:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Some people think public transport should be free for everyone, while others believe passengers should pay the full cost of every journey they make. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
